name: form-copilot
description: Fixed-form synthetic rehearsal scheduler with Vite, NestJS and PostgreSQL.

scripts.predev: npm run build -w @form-copilot/contracts && npm run build -w @form-copilot/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @form-copilot/api" "npm run dev -w @form-copilot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @form-copilot/contracts && npm run build -w @form-copilot/api && npm run build -w @form-copilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @form-copilot/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @form-copilot/api && npm run typecheck -w @form-copilot/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @form-copilot/contracts && npm run test -w @form-copilot/api && node --test apps/web/src/schedule.test.mjs apps/web/src/api.test.mjs apps/web/src/batch-status.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
